description: This file configures and manages the 464xlat CLAT protocol, handling IPv6 to IPv4 translation setup and teardown, incorporating network configurations, ip rules, and firewall rules.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_setup
methods.description: Configures IPv6 to IPv4 translation settings, network rules, and firewall configuration for a specific instance.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up the configuration, removing network rules, and temporary files associated with a specific 464xlat instance.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the 464xlat protocol.
